The forward-looking full-year adjusted EBITDA and revenue ranges were also revised lower while the adjusted EPS range was left unchanged, which is a guidance revision rather than realized performance and is not internally reconcilable from these rows alone. interpretation_requires_review.counterevidence: The one clearly favorable selected row is non-GAAP free cash flow, which rose sharply against a period of lower earnings and lower adjusted profitability. Because free cash flow is a cash measure that can be driven by working-capital timing, collections, capitalized or deferred items and other balance-sheet movements not present in this extract, it is genuine opposing evidence against a simple 'everything deteriorated' reading but does not by itself establish improved underlying profitability. The unchanged adjusted EPS guidance range alongside lower adjusted EBITDA and revenue ranges is a second, weaker tension: it may reflect below-the-line items, share count, tax or non-operating effects, but the extract provides no bridge to confirm that, so it is noted as unresolved rather than as support for stability.
interpretation_requires_review.uncertainty: All comparisons are sequential only; no year-over-year context is available, so seasonality and normal quarterly cadence cannot be separated from genuine change.
